_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language, for the website now and the game's .po files later. World names (characters, places, coins, canon fish) come from HusbandOutWorld content/i18n/ar/glossary.json: the series wins, so if a spelling there changes, change it here too. Game-only names (fish made for this game) are added here.
rule: Story names in Arabic letters, by sound (ف for v, غ for hard g, ج for soft g/j as in Itagiba). This covers coined world terms too: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People = وود بيبول, Sapphire = سافاير, Bleed Out = بليد آوت). Parts of names are separated by spaces (هاري سانبي, أروكيا لونغ بريدج); hyphenated surnames are written as separate words (تاف هامر). Arabic has no o/u distinction, so where two coined names would look the same (Sunnolow / Sunnulow) the Latin spelling follows in brackets in lists. Plain words are translated (Nari Stones = أحجار ناري, Black Honey = العسل الأسود). The currency balls is كرات (one كرة; Sapphire Ball = كرة سافاير); the unit timehunk stays in Latin letters, as do A.G./B.G. Real people (Deovandski, Mitsukiven, Feiourm), the title, Webtoons and pets named in the afterwords (Peeta, Fluffy, Maddog) stay in Latin letters. Text runs right to left; numbers, URLs and file names stay as they are.
